test_string_na_values: test reading CSV with empty string fields are converted to NaN values

test_non_string_na_values: test custom non-string NA values like -999 are recognized as null in CSV data
test_default_na_values: test that all default NA value strings are correctly identified as null during CSV parsing
test_custom_na_values: test specifying custom NA value strings with skiprows when parsing CSV data
test_bool_na_values: test boolean columns with NA values are handled correctly during CSV parsing
test_na_value_dict: test per-column NA value mapping using a dictionary in read_csv
test_na_value_dict_multi_index: test per-column NA value mapping with MultiIndex columns during CSV parsing
test_na_values_keep_default: test keep_default_na flag combined with custom na_values overrides default NA detection
test_no_na_values_no_keep_default: test keep_default_na=False prevents default NA values from being parsed
test_no_keep_default_na_dict_na_values: test combining keep_default_na=False with dict-based na_values for selective NA detection
test_na_values_na_filter_override: test na_filter=False suppresses all NA value detection including default strings
test_na_trailing_columns: test trailing missing columns in CSV rows are filled with NaN values
test_na_values_scalar: test scalar na_values parameter converts matching values to NaN across all columns
test_na_values_dict_aliasing: test that na_values dictionary passed to read_csv is not mutated during parsing
test_na_values_dict_null_column_name: test per-column NA mapping when column names include None entries
test_na_values_uint64: test NA value handling with large unsigned 64-bit integer values
test_no_na_filter_on_index: test na_filter=False prevents NA detection on index columns
test_inf_na_values_with_int_index: test inf and -inf as NA values with integer index column
test_na_values_with_dtype_str_and_na_fil: test NA filtering behavior when dtype is set to string
test_cast_NA_to_bool_raises_error: test that casting a boolean column with NA values raises ValueError
test_bool_and_nan_to_int: test that converting NaN values to integer dtype raises ValueError
test_bool_and_nan_to_float: test that NaN values are correctly converted to float NaN during CSV parsing
test_na_values_dict_without_dtype: test custom numeric NA values like -99.0 are recognized without explicit dtype
